prompt:
Generate a transparent game SPRITE SHEET of nine trees. Use the attached geometry as the elevated isometric CAMERA guide: top faces are very visible, trunks short below the canopy, radial branch spread in the horizontal2:1 plane. Replace the simple geometry with restrained painted organic trees. IMPORTANT remove every green ground diamond completely to alpha0. Do NOT return frontal tree illustrations. Camera looks down onto the TOP of crowns from35 degrees elevation, fixed orthographic three-quarter view. Crown tops and layered radial foliage dominate, crowns conceal inner trunk forks. Northwest light, muted sage and deep olive greens, warm brown wood. Full plants with clear empty gutters in exactly3x3 equal square cells. No tiny leaves or needles, lettering or UI. Root foot near85% cell height; canopy and branches wholly contained in its own cell. 
Subjects ONLY from this list, keep botanical identity but canopy view overrides any frontal trunk/fork description. Cold blue/sage green with restrained snow on canopy TOP surfaces and pale trunks.
Slot 1: arctic-birch, 4.67m tall, 92.0px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Low many-stemmed silver trunk with a spreading rounded sage crown.
Slot 2: mountain-birch, 6.67m tall, 131.5px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Bent pale trunks and a broad windswept yellow-green crown with light snow.
Slot 3: silver-birch, 9.33m tall, 184.1px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Tall white trunk with a loose light silvery green crown and open lower branches.
Slot 4: grey-alder, 7.33m tall, 144.6px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Compact cool green oval crown above several silver-grey trunks.
Slot 5: green-alder, 5.33m tall, 105.2px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Low wide dark green lobed crown on visibly branching warm grey stems.
Slot 6: balsam-poplar, 9.33m tall, 184.1px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Upright broad oval blue-green crown on a straight dark trunk.
Slot 7: quaking-aspen, 8.67m tall, 170.9px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Slender pale trunk and a rounded muted golden crown with large leaf masses.
Slot 8: feltleaf-willow, 5.33m tall, 105.2px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Low spreading silvery sage crown above an open forked cool brown trunk.
Slot 9: goat-willow, 6.67m tall, 131.5px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Broad rounded grey-green crown on a stout branching pale trunk, sparse snow.
Relative size comes from metre heights; do not fit all plants to equal heights. Complete crown and root foot, no ground discs. 12% empty gutter. Natural irregular foliage, visible radial crown TOPS conceal80% of trunks.
